fit_complexity: Let n be input training rows, P features, R=min(n,24576), Q<=min(P,96), K<=min(P,512), U<=min(R,512), H=4 ridge penalties, S<=48 coordinate passes, F<=min(Q,32+Q/4), B<=64 bins, D<=6, T<=640 trees. Validation and final refit cost O(n(P+1)+P+UK+QR log R+HSRQ+TDRF+T*2^D*FB+TRD); both phases and all internal selection are included up to constant factors.
predict_complexity: For m prediction rows: O(mP+mQ log B+mTD), including validation of all input features; Q<=96, B<=64, D<=6, T<=640.
memory_complexity: Additional fitting storage O(RQ+R+K+QB+T*2^D); fitted state O(QB+T*2^D+Q); prediction additional storage O(m+Q). The caller's training input occupies O(n(P+1)) and prediction input O(mP), charged separately to the same process limit.
